name: cluster-health
description: Read-only Kubernetes triage from kubectl output you paste (get pods -A, get nodes, get events -A, top nodes/pods, get deploy/rs/sts/ds, describe pod/node, rollout history). It flags CrashLoopBackOff and OOMKilled pods, image pull failures, Pending pods with their FailedScheduling reason, restart storms, not-ready pods, evictions, NotReady or pressured nodes, CPU/memory pressure and unhealthy or recent rollouts, each with the verbatim evidence line, a ranked severity and a suggested read-only next command. Thresholds are fixed in code (restart storm 5 restarts within 60m, Pending 10m, pressure 85%, recent rollout 24h) and every count is computed in code. It can also read a read-only cluster connector if you enabled one. It never restarts, deletes, scales or changes anything and answers nothing outside cluster health.

skills.name: Cluster health triage
skills.description: Ranked issues from pasted kubectl output: crash loops, OOM kills, image pulls, unschedulable pods, restart storms, node and resource pressure, unhealthy rollouts, each with evidence and a read-only next command.
examples: Here is kubectl get pods -A: what is unhealthy? <paste>
